She must have taken bank loans to purchase the properties and must have paid bank interest also. She suggested to me to invest my amount in her business and she would give me 14% profit for the first year. Each year the profit percentage changes. For last year I got about 18% profit. It is also agreed that if she incur losses, the losses will be shared by me also. Further she said after deducting all the maintenance expenses etc., the profit will be calculated each year. Suppose I discontinue the business with her and if I get back my whole amount, should I pay the Zakath for the previous years when the amount was in her possession or should I pay the Zakath once the amount come to me and remain with me for one full year? answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 41619 Country: India Title: Income from Commission on Property Dealing Question: My question is regarding the income from property dealing which comes as 1 or 2 percent commission. Is it halal or not permissible haram for Muslims? If we earn commission on sale purchase of vehicles or properties is it permissible or halal for us or not. Please guide me in the light of the holy Quran and Hadith. Answer ID: 41619 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 985/992/N=1433) It is lawful as per the Shariah to do brokerage and take the commission as per the percentage from the person for whom brokerage is done for the sale and purchase of the property or vehicles etc keeping oneself away from deception and cheating. Thus the amount of the commission will be lawful and halal. (Islam Aur Jadid Masail 2:200-201) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
